# Specification: community garden plot booking

## Outcome and non-goals

Neighbours reserve one plot for a season. Payments, maps, and accounts are out of scope.

## Requirements

### R1. Plot records

Each plot has a name, a size, and a season label.

### R2. Overlap rules

Two bookings for the same plot and the same season cannot both be active.

### R3. Waitlist

A full plot keeps a short waitlist in arrival order.

### R4. Public calendar

A shared board shows which plots are free. This requirement is not given to any task.
